tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpon slob yol mo sprul sku'i spyan ltas yod/ dge legs 'phel// bden don mchog gzigs gang thugs lte ba'i rin chen mkha' ltar dri ma med/ /bsam yas chos kyi rtsibs stong rab 'bar the tshom dra ba ma lus gcod/ /nam yang ma smad grags pa'i khor yug shin tu rgya che'i mu 'khyud mdzes/ /'khor lo rin chen bla ma'i zhabs la dngos po kun gyis btud nas su/ /nyin mor byed pa 'od kyi lang tsho rngam pa'i drung / /me khyer sgron me'i snyem 'chang gzu lum ji lta bur/ /shes bya kun gzigs chos kyi rgyal po'i lha snyan mchog /mi shes blos brtags mching bu'i snyan chas mdzes ma lags/ /'on kyang ma ltar lhag par brtse bas yongs bzung zhing / /mchog gsang bla med dkyil 'khor chen por bdag rjes bzung / /bka' drin mtshungs med khyab bdag dges pa'i zhal gyi lung / /spyi bor yongs mnos nying 'khrul lam du shar 'di gsol/ /de yang chos srid gnyis ldan gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po dpal sa skya pa khyab bdag rigs kyi gtso bo mchog gis bka' stsal du phebs pa'i don tshan 'ga' zhig mchis par brtag dpyad zhus par/ bdag la rmi lam yang 'khrul gyi snang ba la bud med 'dra'i shod mkhan yong ba gcig yod pa/ bud med sngo zu le ba gos hrul po gsum brtsegs gyon pa 'brum tshag thug se ba/ ske la gzi'i 'phreng ba nyis rim yod pa gcig byung lags/ de la sku tshe'i tshad kyi nges pa dris pas/ tshe mthar phyin pa yong / dam grib dang dme grib la 'dzem dgos zer ba byung / de dang u rgyan sku tshab la brtag bsgril zhus pa mthun par/ dgung lo drug cu kha gdal bzhugs pa mthun/ 'on kyang dam grib dme grib gnyis la brten pa'i sku tshe'i 'phrang chen de/ dgung lo lnga bcu tshun la cung zad nyen che ba 'dra gcig 'dug pas/ tshe sgrub dang grib sel/ sku khrus la thugs rtsol gyi thon pa gnang dgos rigs su 'dug lags/

sku don gnyis pa rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob 'jam dbyangs rgyud pa 'byon mi 'byon dris pas/ lar dus snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug sems can la bsod nams med pas/ dhīḥyig mi dmigs dbyings su bsdus pa'i dus yin kyang / rten 'brel 'grigs na rigs rgyud sprul sku 'byon zhes dang / de yang yol gdong nas dang / ko lcag pa'i lcam gzhon pa gnyis nyen che zhes pa yang / brtag pa dang rtse mthun byung lugs/ ko lcag nas lcam la legs thabs kun thub sogs kyi sku bsrung gal che ba dang / ma ning nag po la rgyu phyag nas bka' drin bskyangs ngos bskang bshags brgya stong mang po gnang dgos/ sngar gdung la bar du gcod byed lha mo nag mo gcig gis byas zhu yin 'dug lags/ dmag zor ma a yin/ 'bri khung lha mo 'dra gcig e yin byas tsa na/ sngar skyob pa'i lha ru yod/ phyis gnod pa'i 'dre ru langs zhu ba dang / nyi ma byang shar mtshams kyi bandhas mnan gtad dang rbad 'dres kyang gegs byas zhu ba 'dug lags/ gegs de rnams la bcos thabs byas na gdung 'dzin skyes bu yong zhu ba 'dug lags/ sku don dgongs gtad kyi gtso bo'i thad/ bdag rang gi bsam tshul ni/ mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / bstan pa'i bya ba las skad cig kyang mi g.yel zhing / lugs zung gi mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bdag rang gi rmi lam sogs gang nas brtags kyang / sngags 'chang chen po ltar bsam bzhin du sprul pa'i skur byon pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa gcig yin nges bsam pa gcig yod rung / dgongs bzhed dang bstun dris shing brtsad pa'i lan/ lar skyes bu chen po 'di'i yin lugs ni/ rigs rdo rje'i rigs/ rus gzugs can gyi lha/ sngar paṇḍi ta'i lus gsum btud mar blangs nas mkhas pa'i bya ba byas/ da lta bla med ma rgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin/ grogs mon bu nag po dang 'brog gnas kyis byed/ 'di'i 'og tu paṇḍi ta'i bya ba lhag ma byed/

de'i 'og tu sbas pa'i spyod pas sa lam bsgrod/ de nas mkha' 'gro bye ba dang / dpa' bo 'bum sde lngas he ru ka'i zhing du skyel/ de dus sa lam lhag ma bsgrod/ mkha' spyod gtso mo'i yab tu 'gyur/ 'on kyang bde ba can nyid don du gnyer na/ bcom ldan zhing de'i ston pa'i sku stong rtsa bzhengs/ sor rtog ye shes rgyud la sbyangs/ 'chi nges sems can brgya rtsa'i srog blu dgos/ sbyin sreg kyang ci mang dgos/ bde chen smon lam dus bzhir chag med bya/ phyag rgya padma can gcig la ma chags 'dzag med thabs kyi sbyor ba bya/ de nyid 'dod chags rdo rjes rgyas btab nas/ bde ba'i rang bzhin stong par sbyor/ sku tshe 'di la mdzad pa mi rdzogs pas/ da dung skye srid gnyis ni nges par 'dzin/ lan gcig mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid/ de nas bde ba can du rten 'brel stobs las skye zer ba byung lags/ spyan gyi thad du dris pas/ lo gcig mig 'grib rgyu dang rkyen la 'dzems/ grib dang mi gtsang rgyun du bsrung / lha yi mig ltar gsal rig mun pa med zer ba byung lags/ drung rabs drung gi skye gnas la dris shing brtsad pas/ he he zhes gad mo bgad nas/ lar ni skyes bu chen po dang skye gnas gcig tu skye ba'i smon lam btab/ de'i dbang gis mthar ni gnas der skye/ 'on kyang dam tshig nyams pa'i rtsa ltung dag pa dgos/ de la tshogs 'khor brgya rtsa/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brgya rtsa/ sā tsha brgya rtsa/ he ru ka'i yig brgya 'bum tsho lnga/ de rnams byas pas/ skye ba bzhi lnga las kyi lhag ma spyod/ de nas skyes bu chen po he ru ka'i gnas su spyod na/ 'khor gyi 'dus pa gnyis par 'gyur/ yang bde ba can du 'byon na yang lhan cig bcom ldan 'das la chos nyan skal ba thob zer ba byung bas/ drung rabs pa bgres po la sku tshe 'di la med na'ang / sku tshe sngon ma gcig gang ltar dam tshig gi nyes ltung phran bu 'phog nges su 'dug pa sbyangs pa'i cho ga de rnams gal che lags/

zol med du phul ba'i zhu 'phrin lags/ dam can chos skyong thugs mi khrel ba yod lags/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpon slob yol mo sprul sku'i spyan ltas yod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
